variantReplayGate.cause: a race in the fixture, not the lot: four variants are noted under one program; their replay order is by the millisecond each was noted in (all in one: by id; otherwise as noted). On a host with one compile worker (fewer than 8 processors: the runner and this sandbox) and the order "as noted", the replay of the variant that must fail under memory pressure runs second and waits, on the only worker, for outcomes that worker has still to produce; it gives up after 3 s, memory then reads short for good and the variant that builds is held
variantReplayGate.reproduced: locally with 3 ms between the four notes: the same three figures as the runner, exactly

variantReplayGate.gate: one program per variant, offered one after the other: each replay is alone in flight and its outcome is classified with the memory reading meant for it, whatever the number of workers and the order; the expected figures are unchanged
variantReplayGate.stress: with 3 ms after each of the 29 notes of the fixture the gate passes (107 checks); variant-replay-all, which shares the fixture, passes (40 checks)
